units.title: SG-11.1 Phaser scene listens for playAnimation on the event bus
Act: Subscribe BootScene to playAnimation and dispatch to character sprites
Act: Unsubscribe playAnimation in the BootScene SHUTDOWN handler
Verify: BootScene plays character animation on playAnimation unit tests

tests.id: bootScenePlayAnimation > plays the interact animation on the target character when playAnimation names interact
tests.name: BootScene playAnimation: interact plays boy-interact key
tests.title: BootScene plays the boy interact animation when playAnimation names interact for the boy
tests.scenario: Given BootScene has created the boy sprite, When playAnimation is emitted with target boy and name interact, Then sprite.play is last called with character:boy-interact:interact

tests.id: bootScenePlayAnimation > plays the idle animation on the target character when playAnimation names idle
tests.name: BootScene playAnimation: idle plays boy idle key
tests.title: BootScene plays the boy idle animation when playAnimation names idle for the boy
tests.scenario: Given BootScene has created the boy sprite, When playAnimation is emitted with target boy and name idle, Then sprite.play is last called with character:boy:idle

tests.id: bootScenePlayAnimation > ignores playAnimation for an unknown target and plays nothing
tests.name: BootScene playAnimation: unknown target ignored
tests.title: BootScene ignores playAnimation for an unknown target and plays nothing
tests.scenario: Given BootScene has created the boy sprite, When playAnimation is emitted with target ghost, Then the sprite play call count is unchanged

units.title: Verify: playAnimation unsubscribe on shutdown unit tests

tests.id: bootScenePlayAnimationShutdown.test.ts > plays the character animation for a playAnimation event before shutdown
tests.name: plays the character animation for a playAnimation event before shutdown
tests.title: BootScene plays the character animation for a playAnimation event before shutdown
tests.scenario: Given BootScene is created and SHUTDOWN has not run; When playAnimation targets boy with interact; Then sprite.play is called with character:boy-interact:interact
tests.detail: Positive control so the shutdown assertions are not vacuous.

tests.id: bootScenePlayAnimationShutdown.test.ts > starts no character animation for playAnimation events after the SHUTDOWN callback runs
tests.name: starts no character animation for playAnimation events after the SHUTDOWN callback runs
tests.title: BootScene starts no character animation for playAnimation events after shutdown
tests.scenario: Given the captured SHUTDOWN callback has run; When playAnimation targets boy with interact; Then the sprite play call count is unchanged

tests.id: bootScenePlayAnimationShutdown.test.ts > leaves other playAnimation subscribers registered before create() active after shutdown
tests.name: leaves other playAnimation subscribers registered before create() active after shutdown
tests.title: Other playAnimation subscribers keep receiving events after BootScene shutdown
tests.scenario: Given a spy subscribed before create(); When SHUTDOWN runs and playAnimation is emitted; Then the spy receives the payload and BootScene plays nothing

units.title: REQ · BootScene plays the matching character animation on playAnimation
REQ · BootScene releases the playAnimation subscription on shutdown
Evidence: BootScene playAnimation subscribe and shutdown unit tests
